ud3.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.2:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ ārocesi
ud3.2:1.5: na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti.
ud3.2:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.2:2.2: āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ ārocesi
ud3.2:2.3: anabhirato ahaṃ āvuso brahmacariyaṃ carāmi na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti.
ud3.2:3.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
ud3.2:3.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena nandaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi
ud3.2:3.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā nando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ etadavoca
ud3.2:4.1: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā nando tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
ud3.2:5.1: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ nanda sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ ārocesi
ud3.2:6.1: kissa pana tvaṃ nanda anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carasi na sakkosi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissasīti.
ud3.2:6.2: sākiyānī mama bhante janapadakalyāṇī gharā nikkhamantassa upaḍḍhullikhitehi kesehi apaloketvā maṃ etadavoca
ud3.2:6.4: so kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ anussaramāno anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carāmi na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti.
ud3.2:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāya gahetvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evamevaṃ jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
ud3.2:8.1: tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni accharāsatāni sakkassa devānamindassa upaṭṭhānaṃ āgatāni honti kukkuṭapādānī.
ud3.2:8.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ āmantesi
ud3.2:8.3: passasi no tvaṃ nanda imāni pañca accharāsatāni kukkuṭapādānīti.
ud3.2:9.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi nanda katamā nu kho abhirūpatarā vā dassanīyatarā vā pāsādikatarā vā sākiyānī vā janapadakalyāṇī imāni vā pañca accharāsatāni kukkuṭapādānīti.
ud3.2:9.3: evameva kho bhante sākiyānī janapada kalyāṇī imesaṃ pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhyampi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti upanidhimpi na upeti
ud3.2:9.4: atha kho imāni pañca accharāsatāni abhirūpatarāni ceva dassanīyatarāni ca pāsādikatarāni cāti.
ud3.2:10.2: ahante pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kukkuṭapādānanti.
ud3.2:10.3: sace me bhante bhagavā pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kukkuṭapādānaṃ abhiramissāmahaṃ bhante bhagavā brahmacariyeti.
ud3.2:11.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāya gahetvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evamevaṃ devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito jetavane pāturahosi.
ud3.2:12.2: āyasmā kira nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati
ud3.2:12.3: bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kukkuṭapādānanti.
ud3.2:13.1: atha kho āyasmato nandassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitavādena ca samudācaranti
ud3.2:13.2: bhatako kirāyasmā nando upakkitako kirāyasmā nando accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati
ud3.2:13.3: bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kukkuṭapādānanti.
ud3.2:14.1: atha kho āyasmā nando sahāyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitavādena ca aṭṭiyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
ud3.2:14.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
ud3.2:14.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā nando arahataṃ ahosi.
ud3.2:15.1: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.2:15.2: āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
ud3.2:15.4: nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
ud3.2:16.1: atha kho āyasmā nando tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā nando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.2:16.2: yaṃ me bhante bhagavā pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kukkuṭapādānaṃ muñcāmahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ etasmā paṭissavāti.
ud3.2:16.3: mayāpi kho te nanda cetasā ceto paricca vidito
ud3.2:16.4: nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti
ud3.2:16.6: āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti
ud3.2:16.7: yadeva kho te nanda anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ athāhaṃ mutto etasmā paṭissavāti.
ud3.2:17.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
